name: Outcome Evaluation
purpose: Compare every fixed success signal with verified post-ST-08 Evidence, preserve an honest Outcome, and complete the Intent without inventing a backward route.
completion_criteria: Core fixes every expected outcome, success signal, Requirement, and available approved acceptance criterion into the Outcome Work Request with a stable ID.
Every required signal has exactly one result and one or more verified Evidence references; unknown fields, arbitrary commands, secrets, and unbound Evidence are rejected.
A released, rolled_back, or not_applicable Release Current is evaluated without conflating the three outcomes; rolled_back is never automatically called achieved.
Core may auto-complete only when every required signal is achieved and all Evidence references pass integrity validation.
A human decides whether partial, failed, or inconclusive results continue observation, complete honestly, or complete with a Follow-up Brief draft.
The not_applicable disposition is rejected because every Intent must retain an Outcome and closure reason.
Core writes canonical Outcome Current and derived escaped HTML, records the terminal audit event, and changes State to completed without adding a backward Graph edge.
stop_conditions: A promised signal, pinned input, Effective Policy, Release Current, Evidence reference, observation timestamp, Evaluation, or human decision is missing, malformed, stale, tampered, or inconsistent.
The observation window has not opened, its deadline has expired without an explicit human decision, or an Evidence source is outside the Project boundary.
An AI proposal contains a Stage transition, arbitrary shell command, secret value, human decision, Follow-up Intent creation, or an unregistered observation operation.
A rolled_back Release is proposed as achieved, or a partial, failed, or inconclusive Outcome is completed without an exact human decision.
